bm-1Tff.title: Houses: big dense multi-storey buildings
bm-1Tff.summary: The largest town has many large, tightly packed multi-storey buildings, which stand out on an island of mostly small houses.

bm-2FIK.title: Landscape: ocean always near, light blue water
bm-2FIK.summary: You are never far from the sea, and the water very often looks distinctly light blue.

bm-2tb7.title: Driving side: left
bm-2tb7.summary: Traffic drives on the left side of the road.

bm-8UWt.title: Coverage: boat trekker around a harbour and
bm-8UWt.summary: A boat trekker on the eastern coast, going around a harbour and past an old fort on the northeast tip of the island.

bm-Wp1S.title: Plate: all white, black digits in the middle
bm-Wp1S.summary: Fairly long, all-white plates with black digits sitting mostly in the middle of the plate.

bm-Zzvj.title: Road lines: white zigzag
bm-Zzvj.summary: You will now and then see white zigzag lines painted on the road.

bm-iYFp.title: Google car: black, front sides visible
bm-iYFp.summary: A black Street View car, with the whole front sides of the vehicle usually visible in the picture.

bm-mcLU.title: Plants: dense small trees and bushes
bm-mcLU.summary: Dense vegetation of fairly small trees and lots of bushes, with single-family houses spread across the landscape.

bm-pS17.title: Road lines: one solid yellow centre line
bm-pS17.summary: Most roads have a single solid yellow line down the middle and no edge lines.

bm-plHU.title: Houses: pastel stone, white roofs
bm-plHU.summary: Single-family stone houses painted in pastel colours, almost always with completely white roofs.

bm-rKvn.title: Territory: British overseas islands
bm-rKvn.summary: A small British territory in the Atlantic, north of the Caribbean. For country streaks it counts as the United Kingdom.

bm-wEtL.title: Houses: large unpainted grey brick buildings
bm-wEtL.summary: At the northwestern tip, many large buildings are made of unpainted grey brick.
